---
title: "World Flags"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(countrycode)

# List all flag images and map country codes to full country names
files <- list.files("data/flags", pattern = "\\.png$")
codes <- sub("\\.png$", "", files)

custom_match <- c(
  "GB-ENG" = "England",
  "GB-NIR" = "Northern Ireland",
  "GB-SCT" = "Scotland",
  "GB-WLS" = "Wales",
  "XK"     = "Kosovo"
)

flag_data <- tibble(
  code = codes,
  name = countrycode(toupper(codes), "iso2c", "country.name", custom_match = custom_match),
  path = paste0("data/flags/", files)
) |>
  filter(!is.na(name)) |>
  arrange(name)

# Pass data from R to Observable JS
ojs_define(countries = flag_data)
```

```{ojs}
// Dropdown to select a country
viewof selected = Inputs.select(transpose(countries), {
  label: "Select Country:",
  format: d => d.name,
  value: transpose(countries).find(d => d.name === "United States")
})
```

```{ojs}
// Display the selected country flag
html`
<div style="margin-top: 1.5rem;">
  <h3>${selected.name}</h3>
  <img src="${selected.path}" alt="${selected.name} flag" style="max-width: 500px; width: 100%; border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);" />
</div>
`
```
